title: Definitions (Benami property, Benami transaction, real owner)
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, Act VIII of 2017
text_normalized: benami property means any property subject of benami transaction

title: Prohibition of Benami transactions
text:
(1) No person shall enter into any Benami transaction.
(2) Whoever enters into any Benami transaction or abets the commission of a Benami transaction shall be guilty of the offence of Benami transaction.
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, Act VIII of 2017

title: Prohibition of the right to recover property held benami
text:
(1) No suit, claim or action to enforce any right in respect of any property held benami against the person in whose name the property is held or against any other person shall lie by or on behalf of a person claiming to be the real owner of such property.
(2) No defence based on any right in respect of any property held benami, whether against the person in whose name the property is held or against any other person, shall be allowed in any suit, claim or action, by or on behalf of a person claiming to be the real owner of such property.
(3) Nothing in this section shall apply,--
(a) where the person in whose name the property is held is a trustee or other person standing in a fiduciary capacity, and the property is held for the benefit of another person for whom he is a trustee or towards whom he stands in such capacity; or
(b) where the person in whose name the property is held is an executor, administrator or other representative, and the property is held for the benefit of another person.

title: Property held in Benami liable to confiscation
text: Any property, which is subject-matter of a Benami transaction, shall be liable to be confiscated by the Federal Government.
